description: This file defines the SentenceAggregator class, a frame processor for the Pipecat project that accumulates text frames into complete sentences based on sentence-ending patterns, emitting full sentences downstream.

classes.name: SentenceAggregator
classes.description: Aggregates text frames into complete sentences by buffering incoming TextFrame objects and emitting them once a sentence-ending pattern is detected.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the SentenceAggregator, setting up internal sentence buffer.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes each incoming frame, accumulating text until a sentence end is detected or an end frame is received, then emits the completed sentence.

ctags.name: process_frame
ctags.pattern: /^    async def process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection):$/
